# MCP Scope Consent

MCP Scope Consent is a hosted remote MCP for MCP consent scope receipt.

Website: https://mcpscopeconsent.clauxel.com/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: MCP consent scope receipt
Type: MCP
Default plan: team
MCP endpoint: https://mcpscopeconsent.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://mcpscopeconsent.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Registry name: com.clauxel.mcpscopeconsent/mcpscopeconsent-mcp
Tools: check_scope_consent, issue_consent_receipt, explain_scope_policy, log_tool_call, export_scope_audit

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
